caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair positioned at a slight angle so that both the seat and backrest are visible. The chair is brown with carved elements on the backrest, which features interlaced X-shaped wooden slats and a horizontal panel at the top with carved decorative detail. The legs are fluted and taper towards the bottom, with the front two legs showing additional turned details near the seat. The armrests are curved and connect to the upper part of the front legs, which have carved vertical accents. The seat is upholstered with a fabric that is predominantly a greenish-blue color, adorned with lighter blue, white, and grey floral or paisley patterns. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with subtle shading underneath the chair to suggest shadow.
title: Armchair
